frasi.consigli: Citizenship ceremonies are usually organised by local government councils.
frasi.indirizzo: Which council-hosted ceremony you will attend is determined by your current residential address.
frasi.scelta: You cannot choose where and when to attend your ceremony.
frasi.invito: You will be invited to attend your ceremony about four weeks before the event.
frasi.lettera: You will receive a letter of invitation from either your local council or the Department of Home Affairs.
frasi.domanda_locale: The wait time for a ceremony depends on the demand in your local government area.
frasi.famiglia: Having family members linked to your application may also affect your wait time.
